professionalSummary.text: Develops fleet traffic-management or task-allocation services in C++ or Python.
professionalSummary.witness: Rewrote the task-allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight-line distance.

experienceHighlights.text: Extends a layout simulator used to test fleet behaviour before site changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Added one-way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator, and ran each customer's proposed layout through it before the site engineers changed the floor plan.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Shows a measured improvement in robot idle time or throughput from fleet telemetry against a baseline period.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: At the Daventry and Leeds customer sites, robot idle time went from 14.0% of shift time in the baseline fortnight (6 to 19 February 2023) to 9.6% after the new allocation went into service (20 March to 2 April 2023), measured from fleet telemetry.

skills.text: Writes field diagnostics and supports site engineers during robot stalls.
skills.witness: Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.
